title: Pursuit/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "We are in pursuit of a courier class ship that is transporting material vital to our course. Do not let is escape."
- Lotus: "Hunt down and capture this courier class ship. We need what's inside."
- Lotus: "There is the ship. Close the distance and intercept."
- Lotus: "You found the ship. Give chase."
- Lotus: "Slow it down. Concentrate fire on its engines."
- Lotus: "Aim for the engines. Don't let it get away."
- Lotus: "The engines are down. It's a sitting duck."
- Lotus: "You took out the engines. They're not going anywhere."
- Lotus: "Their engines are online again. They are moving."
- Lotus: "Blow open those shield generators and expose the ships vital systems."
- Lotus: "Take out its shield by destroying its generators."
- Lotus: "Generators are down, now target ship systems."
- Lotus: "Turrets down. They can't return fire now."
- Lotus: "You're losing them. If u let the currier get any further away you'll have no chance of catching them up."
- Lotus: "You need to get closer, the currier is about to escape."
- Lotus: "If that ship escapes this mission will be a failur."
- Lotus: "The currier escaped. I am aborting the mission."
- Lotus: "The ship outran you. There is nothing more we can do here."
- Lotus: "Good work the ship is disabled. Wait, they're attacking the currier ship to keep us from it. Keep it safe."
- Lotus: "You disabled the currier, but this isn't over yet. They're going to try to destroy it to keep it out of our hands. Do net let them succeed."
- Lotus: "My recovery team is on rout. The Grineer will destroy the ship before they let us take it. Defend the ship."
- Lotus: "Keep defending. My recovery team ist almost there."
- Lotus: "Just a little bit longer until recovery arrives."
- Lotus: "Don't let them hit the currier."
- Lotus: "They destroyed the currier. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "Currier destroyed. There is nothing more for us here."
- Lotus: "You secured the black box. We're all done here. Head to extraction."
